## Maharashtra Second-Location Opening Checklist

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
For a Mumbai-based proprietorship opening a second retail shop in a mall, the main work is usually: entity/tax updates, mall approvals, local shop compliance, labor setup, and fit-out readiness.
Because this is a planning checklist, treat items below as a practical preparation sequence, not a legal determination.

## Likely Permits, Documents, and Step Order

| Stage | What to prepare | Typical documents / outputs | Practical timing |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Business setup review | Proprietorship proof, PAN, Aadhaar, existing GST details, bank details, business address proof | 6-9 months before opening |
| 2 | Mall onboarding | Lease draft, LOI, KYC, signatory ID, firm documents, indemnities, insurance drafts | 5-8 months before opening |
| 3 | Tax and registrations | GST amendment/additional place update, professional tax, Shops & Establishments registration for the new premises if applicable | 4-6 months before opening |
| 4 | Local trade compliance | Municipal/trade permissions as required by the mall and local authority, signage approvals, fire/NOC coordination | 3-5 months before opening |
| 5 | Labor and payroll | Employee records, wage structure, ESI/EPF applicability review, appointment letters, attendance system | 2-4 months before opening |
| 6 | Fit-out and operations | Contractor agreements, electrical load approvals, interiors, inventory plan, POS setup, security/CCTV, opening checklist | 1-3 months before opening |
| 7 | Launch readiness | Handover memo, insurance active, staff training, vendor onboarding, opening-day SOPs | 2-4 weeks before opening |

### Documents to Keep Ready
- Proprietorship proof: shop name/firm name usage, owner PAN, Aadhaar, bank proof
- Address proof for existing and new premises
- Lease/leave-and-license draft for the mall unit
- Mall KYC package: proprietor ID, photos, signatures, GST/PAN, business registration copies
- Tax records: GST registration, returns history, invoices, HSN/SAC mapping where relevant
- Employee records for 3 staff: IDs, salary letters, attendance, payroll details
- Insurance: property, public liability, workmen/staff coverage as required by mall/landlord
- Fit-out papers: contractor quote, electrical/layout plan, signage artwork, fire-safety coordination documents

### Permission Areas to Check
- GST registration update for the additional business location
- Maharashtra Shops and Establishments compliance for the new shop
- Mall-specific occupancy, fit-out, and signboard approvals
- Trade/license requirements tied to the exact retail category and mall rules
- Fire safety and building management requirements
- Labor law registrations or applicability checks based on employee count and wage structure
- Insurance and indemnity requirements imposed by the landlord or mall operator

## Practical Preparation Plan for a 2026-09-01 Opening

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg
- 2025 Q2–Q3: confirm business model, budget, and mall shortlist; collect core documents.
- 2025 Q4: negotiate lease terms, verify mall compliance requirements, and map all approvals.
- 2026 Q1: finalize registrations, tax updates, and employee compliance setup.
- 2026 Q2: lock fit-out contractor, signage, insurance, and vendor contracts.
- 2026 Q3: complete handover, stock build, staff training, and soft launch before 2026-09-01.

### Budget Check Against Rent
- Monthly rent: **INR 180,000**
- Annual base rent: **INR 2,160,000**
- Add-ons to plan for: CAM/maintenance, GST on rent if applicable, deposit, fit-out, signage, insurance, staffing, and utilities
- Practical check: make sure fixed monthly occupancy cost is supportable before signing the lease
